evidence.quote:
Gene expression proﬁling has being successfully used to in-
vestigate host genetic responses and has been applied to predict
the responses to treatment and clinical outcome associated with
several diseases, including cancer [13], HIV disease [14], tu-
berculosis [15], and multiple sclerosis [16].

To conﬁrm obser-
vations from the gene chip data, TaqMan Gene Expression
Assays (Applied Biosystems) were used to detect genes in the
immunoproteosome pathway (PSME2, PSMB9, PSMB6, and
PSMA4) in 3 randomly chosen samples from protected and
nonprotected persons, at 2 weeks after the third vaccination.
